title: Mimic Lab
tagline: One Organism. Ten Identities. Infinite Possibilities.
lead: A small octopus from the sandy shallows of the Indo-West Pacific that reshapes its arms, body, colour and movement to resemble other animals. Explore how its body works, and how strong the evidence is for each of the ten identities it is said to take on.
note: The animal shown is a procedural, schematic 3D model built for this site. It is not a scan of a real specimen.
